settings.title: Updates
settings.description: {{product}} looks for new versions on GitHub. It always asks before installing one.
settings.autoCheckHint: At launch and once a day. GitHub sees your IP address and your {{product}} version, as with any download; nothing about your courses is sent.
settings.channelBetaHint: Early versions for testing, plus every stable release.
settings.noStableRelease: {{product}} didn't find a stable release with update information yet. Early versions for testing are on the Beta channel.
settings.downloadHint: This copy of {{product}} was installed from a .deb or .rpm package, so it updates by installing the new package.

install.title: Install {{product}} {{version}}?
install.body: {{product}} downloads the update, checks its signature, installs it and restarts.
install.windows: {{product}} closes while the installer runs, then opens again.
install.aiApp: Afterwards, quit and reopen your AI app so it uses the new {{product}}.
install.availableAfterOtherSync: Available when the other sync (from the command line or another window) finishes
install.held: {{product}} will install the update when the sync finishes.

updated.title: {{product}} was updated to {{version}}
updated.body: Quit and reopen your AI app (Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Codex) so it uses the new {{product}}.

update_check.title: {{product}} now updates itself
update_check.body: Once a day it downloads a small file from GitHub to see whether there's a new version. GitHub sees your IP address and your {{product}} version, as with any download; nothing about your courses is sent. It always asks before installing anything.

course_weeks.title: Weeks and phases for every course
course_weeks.body: Each course shows its current week and phase, and finished courses move to “Past courses”.

course_removal.title: Remove finished courses
course_removal.body: When a course is over, you can remove it from {{product}}. You can undo it for 7 days, and your own course folders are never touched.

onboarding.autoCheckHint: Once a day {{product}} downloads a small file from GitHub to see whether there's a new version. GitHub sees your IP address and your {{product}} version, as with any download; nothing about your courses is sent. It always asks before installing, and you can change this in Settings.
